note: Odoo 19 addon, not a JS package: no package.json, no Storybook, no dist. Its 21 components are Owl (@odoo/owl) and are resolved by Odoo's own asset bundler, so they cannot be compiled into the _ds_bundle.js the design agent renders. Hand-writing React equivalents would be the reimplementation the skill forbids. Only the framework-agnostic style layer is synced: tokens, fonts and stylesheets.
